quotes.text: Vice Admiral Whitworth, the recent awarding of task orders for commercial imagery analysis on your Luno A program and the funding of the Luno B program focused on commercial AI are exactly the kind of commercial integration we need to stay ahead of our adversaries.

Great conversation with @mattmurphyshow on @997wtn about China, the rise of AI and quantum computing in defense, and more.
